_README: Town of Winchester — driveway & right-of-way permit map data.
This file drives row-permits.html. Edit it, commit it, and the public page updates.
REQUIRED per entry: id, title, org, location, lat, lng, startDate, endDate, status
OPTIONAL:          traffic, contactName, contactPhone, jurisdiction, permitNumber, notes
status:            proposed  = on an upcoming Board agenda, not yet decided
approved  = Board approved; the page colours it from the dates
denied    = hidden from the public page entirely
withdrawn = hidden from the public page entirely
jurisdiction:      omit or 'town' for Town permits.
'Vilas County' or 'WisDOT' renders a hollow marker labelled
'Not a Town permit' — use for county/state work shown for information.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Approved entries move upcoming -> active -> finished on their own,
and drop off the map 90 days after endDate. No maintenance needed once dates are right.
Do NOT put applicant home addresses, emails, parcel numbers or internal notes in this file.
It is public. Publish only what a neighbour needs: what, where, when, and who to call.
